headline: Phoenix Legal advises StrideOne on securing investment from Elevar Equity
sum: Stride Fintree Private Limited, dba StrideOne, has secured investments from a fundraise led by Elevar Equity, alongside participation from other investors. Phoenix Legal advised StrideOne on this fundraise.
detail: Stride Fintree Private Limited, dba StrideOne, has secured investments from a fundraise led by Elevar Equity, alongside participation from other investors. Phoenix Legal advised StrideOne on this fundraise. The transaction was led by Ashima Dewan (Partner) along with Srishti Sharma (Senior Associate). Sumit Sinha (Partner) provided structure related advice and other strategic inputs.
